comparisons.architecture: Three Mamba-2 blocks plus attention and speech/turn heads; 16 kHz mono; 40 ms frames; VAD 120 ms lookahead, EOT none.
comparisons.learning_lineage: Publisher ~5,000 h unique audio; training recipe, code and data unreleased.
comparisons.positive: Publisher AMI threshold 0.5: 85.5% within 200 ms vs smart-turn v3.2 30.8%; M3 Max CPU 3.8 ms per 40 ms frame, one stream.
comparisons.negative: AliMeeting VAD AUC 0.9376 vs Silero 0.9635; VAD timing unequal due to lookahead; quiet speech-like noise false positives; no target-speaker selection or independent owner evaluation.
comparisons.reason: Whisper/Granite transcribe and Nemotron diarizes; acoustic-semantic EOT adds a different function. Exact training outcome cannot be reconstructed from released inference source alone.

comparisons.architecture: 48 kHz mono, 46 STFT bands, seven attention/Mamba dual-path blocks, mask+residual; 64M offline and 58.2M causal realtime checkpoints; two trained states, not quantizations.
comparisons.learning_lineage: Publisher ~10,000 h unique training audio; exact training set/reconstruction not established.
comparisons.positive: Publisher VIBE uses common 48 kHz scoring on 5,502 items / 77 conditions; distinct full-band offline and realtime checkpoints. Realtime 63 ms algorithmic delay at 20 ms lookahead.
comparisons.negative: Publisher tuned its own checkpoint; private eval set, 36 items may share training speakers. Independent superiority not established. No restoration or target-speaker selection; similar-level voices may remain, small GPUs untested.
comparisons.reason: Adds waveform denoising rather than transcription/synthesis/diarization; complements existing speech assets. Keep both trained execution regimes under one repository identity.
